item.title: The Philippines: Digitalisation Drives MSME Innovation and Growth
item.description: The DTI is actively helping MSMEs in Siquijor and Ifugao expand markets, embrace digitalisation, adopt modern tools and access vital resources, training programmes and support through digital hubs.

item.title: Australia: Extended Reality Transforms CSI Education
item.description: Murdoch University is using extended reality technology to deliver immersive, accessible crime scene investigation training for forensic science students and professionals to operate in an increasingly tech-savvy world.

item.title: Indonesia, Malaysia to Advance Next-Gen Semiconductors
item.description: Indonesia is strengthening semiconductor capabilities through a Malaysia partnership and a focus on chip design, talent development and domestic manufacturing to reduce import dependence and boost industry resilience.

item.title: Singapore: Enhancing CPF Account Security Amid Rising Digital Fraud
item.description: Singapore enhances personal and regional digital security with CPF Trusted Contact notifications, Safety Switch measures and ASEAN initiatives to combat scams and strengthen cybersecurity resilience.

item.title: Western Sydney University Launches Inclusive AI Education Programme
item.description: Western Sydney University launches free AI literacy and advanced training programmes to build practical, ethical AI skills across students and staff.

item.title: Malaysia: Targeting Six Key Sectors to Accelerate Digital Growth
item.description: Malaysia’s Digital Ministry is driving sector-focused digital transformation across healthcare, transport, agriculture, SMEs, enforcement, and government services, supported by initiatives like the Merdeka 118 MD Nexus.

item.title: The Philippines: Promoting Digital Safety and Well-being in Education
item.description: Western Visayas scholars learned about digital safety, mental health awareness and safe spaces to build resilience, responsible technology use and well-being in learning environments.

item.title: Hong Kong: Strategic Partnerships Strengthen Digital ESG Capabilities
item.description: Renewed partnership focuses on digital ESG tools, smart manufacturing and innovation to help Greater Bay Area firms meet stricter global standards.

item.title: Vietnam: Hanoi Tech Exchange to Boost Innovation, Growth
item.description: Hanoi officially launches HanoTEX and DTMarket to transform innovation and digital solutions into sustainable, scalable economic growth while strengthening collaboration across the city’s innovation ecosystem.

item.title: Singapore: Pragmatic Approach to AI Safety Across Systems, Services
item.description: Singapore is strengthening safeguards, oversight and regulatory frameworks to ensure AI is deployed safely and responsibly while effectively protecting critical systems and users from digital harm.
